purpose: Focused eight-case check of concrete answer delivery and appropriate question/draft outputs; not a full four-mode routing release benchmark.

provenance.author: semantic_router_agent
provenance.authoring_method: Newly authored from the requested category mix and runner case schema, without model calls.
provenance.visible_development_context: The user goal and earlier known original-regression quality failures were available to the author.
excluded_inputs: Fresh release V2 cases and results
provenance.limitations: Small authored diagnostic with predeclared criteria; not a representative sample, statistical accuracy estimate, or proof of quality.

review_protocol.context: Use the runner's isolated empty personal store and production history admission; criteria and expected labels must not be included in model inputs.
review_protocol.control_flow: Optional cases allow general fallback; remaining cases are self-contained or have supplied general task context.
review_protocol.grading_rule: Count genuine deliverable units. A smaller-than-requested but concrete answer is partial, not automatically a nonanswer. Pure offers, task restatements, or unnecessary requests for personalization without a deliverable are nonanswers.
separate_checks: Concrete deliverable and explicit count requirements
Unsupported personal claims or personalization framing
Repetition, physical-action claims, factual concerns, and formatting defects
review_protocol.positive_controls: Actual questions and imperative wording are valid answers when the user explicitly requests those outputs.

cases.text: Give me two ways to reduce distractions while reading at home. Use any saved study preferences if available; otherwise give general suggestions.

required_content: Two distinct actions or environmental changes that could reduce reading distractions.
nonanswer_examples_by_form: Only offers to suggest something later.
Only asks for study preferences.
Repeats the instruction without providing a practical suggestion.
deliverable_criteria.grounding: With no supplied preferences, provide general suggestions without claiming they are based on known personal habits.

cases.text: Make a three-step plan for sorting a crowded email inbox. Adapt it to any stored workflow preferences; if you have none, give a simple general plan.

required_content: An ordered sequence of three concrete inbox-organizing actions.
nonanswer_examples_by_form: Only promises to create a plan.
Asks for preferences instead of giving the permitted general plan.
Says to organize the inbox without describing actions.
deliverable_criteria.grounding: Do not claim access to, inspection of, or modification of the actual inbox or knowledge of an unstated workflow.

cases.text: Suggest two inexpensive things I could make as a thank-you gift. Use any saved craft interests if you know them; otherwise offer general ideas.

required_content: Two identifiable makeable gift ideas, with enough detail to distinguish them.
nonanswer_examples_by_form: Only says to choose a thoughtful gift.
Offers to tailor ideas after learning interests without naming a gift.
Names interests rather than actual things to make.
deliverable_criteria.grounding: Do not invent the user's craft interests or a recipient's preferences. Exact prices are neither required nor supported.

cases.text: Give me a three-item checklist for preparing for a video call. Use saved accessibility preferences if any are available; otherwise provide a general checklist.

required_content: Three concrete preparation checks or actions relevant to joining a video call.
nonanswer_examples_by_form: Only promises a checklist.
Requires disclosure of accessibility needs before providing any general checks.
Repeats that preparation is important without providing checks.
deliverable_criteria.grounding: Do not invent accessibility needs, claim to have tested devices, or claim a setting was changed.

cases.text: Explain in two sentences what a file backup is and why someone would keep one.

required_content: A backup is an additional copy of data kept for possible recovery.
A concrete reason for keeping it, such as recovering after loss or damage.
nonanswer_examples_by_form: Only offers to explain backups.
Repeats the question or calls backups important without explaining them.
deliverable_criteria.grounding: A general explanation is sufficient; do not claim knowledge of the user's files or existing backups.

cases.text: Give me one everyday analogy for that feedback process and explain the comparison.

prior_turns.content: Describe how a thermostat keeps a room near a chosen temperature.
A thermostat compares the measured room temperature with a set temperature. It turns heating on when the room is too cool and off when the target is reached.

required_content: An explicit comparison linking observation, a target, and corrective action to the supplied thermostat feedback process.
nonanswer_examples_by_form: Only says an analogy could help.
Asks what process is meant despite the complete supplied context.
Repeats the thermostat description without giving an analogy.
deliverable_criteria.grounding: Use the supplied general task context; do not invent facts about the user's home or thermostat.

cases.text: Give me exactly two questions to ask a museum guide about how an artifact was made.

required_content: Two usable questions directed to a guide about an artifact's construction, materials, tools, or making process.
deliverable_criteria.positive_control: Questions are the requested deliverable. Delivering appropriate questions must not be rejected merely for asking questions or using question wording.
nonanswer_examples_by_form: Asks the user for the artifact before offering any reusable questions.
Only offers to draft questions.
deliverable_criteria.grounding: Do not assert an artifact's unknown origin, material, or history as fact; asking about those details is appropriate.

cases.text: Write a two-sentence reminder for a shared kitchen asking people to wash their mugs and leave the sink clear. Give only the reminder.

required_content: Ready-to-use reminder wording asking people to wash their mugs.
Ready-to-use wording asking people to leave the sink clear.
deliverable_criteria.positive_control: Polite instructions and direct request wording are the requested draft. They are not a nonanswer merely because they use imperatives or repeat the requested actions.
nonanswer_examples_by_form: Only promises to write the reminder.
Describes what a reminder should say without supplying usable wording.
deliverable_criteria.grounding: This is a supplied drafting situation, not evidence about a personal household; do not invent a named resident or claim to post the reminder.

corpus_fingerprint.serialization: UTF-8 canonical JSON, sorted keys and compact separators, excluding corpus_fingerprint
